slides.label: WHAT IT IS
slides.headline: A second hour hand
slides.body: It shows a second time zone, read against a 24-hour bezel.

slides.label: STEP 1
slides.headline: Keep home time
slides.body: Main hands keep home time. Rolex 126710GRNR: USD 12,000, 26 Nov 2026.

slides.label: STEP 2
slides.headline: Read the second zone
slides.body: The GMT hand points to the 24-hour bezel. Tudor M79830RB-0010: USD 5,275, 26 Nov 2026.

slides.label: WHY COLLECTORS CARE
slides.headline: One watch, two zones
slides.body: Frequent travellers can check a second zone without resetting the watch.

slides.line1: Save this for your next trip
